title: Here I am to Worship
lyrics_original: Opened my eyes, let me see
Hope of a life spent with you
Here I am to bow down
Here I am to say that you’re my God
King of all days Oh so highly exalted
All for love’s sake became poor      || Here I am ||
And I’ll never know How much it cost
To see my sin up on that cross (2)      || Here I am ||

bible_verses.telugu: మరల యేసు నేను లోకమునకు వెలుగును, నన్ను వెంబడించువాడు చీకటిలో నడువక జీవపు వెలుగుగలిగి యుండునని వారితో చెప్పెను.
bible_verses.english: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, 'I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.'

bible_verses.telugu: మనుష్యుల పోలికగా పుట్టి, దాసుని స్వరూపమును ధరించుకొని, తన్ను తానే రిక్తునిగా చేసికొనెను. మరియు, ఆయన  ఆకారమందు  మనుష్యుడుగా  కనబడి, మరణము పొందునంతగా, అనగా సిలువమరణము పొందు నంతగా విధేయత చూపినవాడై, తన్నుతాను తగ్గించుకొనెను.
bible_verses.english: rather, he made himself nothing by taking the very nature of a servant, being made in human likeness. And being found in appearance as a man, he humbled himself by becoming obedient to death—even death on a cross!

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన మన దేవుడు మనము ఆయన పాలించు ప్రజలము ఆయన మేపు గొఱ్ఱలము.
bible_verses.english: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the Lord our Maker.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming into my world and opening my eyes to see Your incredible beauty. I am overwhelmed by Your humility and love for me. Here I am today, stepping into Your presence to bow my heart before You. You alone are altogether lovely and worthy of my devotion. Help me to live this day in worship, honoring You in all I do. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming into my world and opening my eyes to see Your incredible beauty. I am overwhelmed by Your humility and love for me. Here I am today, stepping into Your presence to bow my heart before You. You alone are altogether lovely and worthy of my devotion. Help me to live this day in worship, honoring You in all I do. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Jesus stepped out of heaven's glory directly into our darkness, opening our eyes to behold His beauty and grace. When we truly see the humility and majesty of Christ, our hearts naturally respond in awe and adoration. Worship is not merely a song we sing, but a humble posture of giving Him our entire lives. Today, let His love draw you into His presence, where you can simply bow down and declare that He alone is your God.
